scientific_findings.finding: The advertised real OSP mass-balance gate is non-evidentiary: the real R worker always emits mass_balance_residual=0.0 with a comment that it is a placeholder. Therefore every finite real simulation passes conservation regardless of actual amount balance.

nlmixr2 minimization_successful is not read from optimizer convergence. It is defined as all reported RSE values being finite, so a nonconverged or otherwise invalid fit can be labeled successful and pass the fit-convergence BLOCK gate.

The real Pharmpy load-to-fit contract is broken: load_model returns model.name as model_id, fit later calls read_model(model_id) as if it were the original file path. When Pharmpy is absent with mock=false, operations silently return synthetic mock outputs instead of the README-promised clear error; real Pharmpy VPC is explicitly unimplemented.

Verification BLOCK does not make a decision unaccepted: handlers mutate session/model before gates run, stop_on_block defaults false, and no rollback exists. The default behavior merely feeds the warning to the same LLM, contradicting the claim that trust lives in gates and each decision must prove itself before acceptance.

pkfit covariate VPC does not reproduce the fitted model. fit uses caller covariate_ref but does not persist it; VPC reconstructs the reference from the dataset median. Unless those values coincide, VPC predictions and coverage use a different covariate parameterization than the fit they purport to qualify.

The RA benchmark compares a model flag read at day 600 after a day-285 TCZ switch (315 days, about 45 weeks later) directly with the ROSE week-24 clinical endpoint. These time horizons are not aligned. The same repository also publishes the held-out rates, answer keys and preferred protocol, so it is reproducible but not an independent blinded evaluation and may be memorized or intentionally fit.

Real OSP parameter editing is not wired in the default engine, and real Pharmpy VPC is absent. Several README examples therefore demonstrate decision orchestration over mocks or partial adapters rather than a closed real model-building loop.

security_privacy_findings.finding: The complete modeling goal and every serialized tool result/verification finding are sent to Anthropic without redaction, consent policy or data classification. Real model structures, observed concentration profiles, proprietary parameters and local path metadata can therefore leave the local environment.

LLM-controlled tools accept unrestricted local input paths and snapshot_extract accepts an unrestricted output directory, creating directories and CSV files. Registry dispatch enforces neither filesystem bounds nor approval; Tool.destructive is metadata only and never checked.

Untrusted model/snapshot strings and tool error text are serialized directly into the next LLM user turn, with no untrusted-data delimiter or instruction filtering. A crafted model name, compartment, reaction or error can steer subsequent tool calls, which include local reads/writes and external engine execution.

The provider model is a mutable name rather than a dated immutable snapshot; the Anthropic client call sets no explicit timeout/retry policy or total campaign token budget. max_tokens and max_steps bound individual output/iterations but not dependency drift or deterministic reproducibility.

findings.finding: USPTO document download URLs are accepted from the remote documentBag and fetched with the repository's X-API-KEY header without validating scheme or host. A compromised/malformed API response or redirect can send the USPTO credential to an attacker-controlled origin.

Remote application_number, documentIdentifier and mimeTypeIdentifier values are embedded directly in output directories and filenames. No basename/allowlist/resolve-within-root check prevents path separators or traversal components from escaping the intended DATA/raw/uspto tree before write_bytes.

PubMed and openFDA put API keys (and PubMed contact email) in query parameters. Request exceptions are logged and persisted verbatim by the shared client and jobs; requests exception text commonly includes the prepared URL/query, so transient failures can copy credentials/contact data into ordinary and failure logs.

The main validation report concludes the mechanism needs no further validation, but only 14/702 curated NAR assets were exercised, materialization was limit-bounded, the status-field check is knowingly wrong, and the full post-fix rerun stopped before WIPO/EPO/USPTO/ClinicalTrials.gov. The committed USPTO evidence therefore still predates the Polivy ambiguity fix. This supports a bounded prototype result, not production/general-asset validation.

Committed manifests and reports point to raw HTML/XML/PDF and external NAR markdown that are intentionally absent from Git. Several load-bearing live-verification claims and field-recoverability rows therefore cannot be independently reconstructed from this checkout even though hashes/paths remain. README installation also uses loose pyproject ranges rather than the exact requirements files.

Field recoverability is declared whenever an escaped but unbounded substring appears anywhere in selected row text or a linked patent. The code does not establish semantic relation, negation, entity context, or exact token boundaries despite calling the search whole-word-ish; values such as short targets/dev codes can produce coincidental hits. Counts are useful retrieval leads, not validated recoverable facts.

scientific_contract_findings.finding: OmniDocBench catches invalid ground-truth annotations and drops those references, but leaves the prediction list unfiltered; get_matched_elements then indexes predictions by the shortened reference position. Any parse failure shifts every later prediction/reference pairing and invalidates metrics rather than failing closed.

MMMU key-response parsing lowercases the response before applying a sentence split whose lookahead requires an uppercase letter. That sentence branch can never match; multi-sentence reasoning remains unsplit, and substring matching can credit a gold answer mentioned anywhere in the retained reasoning rather than the final answer.

Heron-Bench pins the dataset revision and reports parse errors, which are positive controls. However the default judge name is unversioned gpt-4o and invalid judge rows are excluded from category means; reproducible comparison requires a frozen judge snapshot/config and explicit coverage threshold.

Selected indices are normalized to strings, but duplicate index values in the dataset frame are not rejected. Multiple rows can share one requested key while checkpoint/result dictionaries are keyed by that string, causing row collapse or ambiguous completeness. Run argv does record the subset, which is a useful provenance control.

LogicVista normalization treats an uninterrupted multi-digit answer such as option 10 as a bag of characters and sorts it to 01; it validates alphanumeric shape but not labels against the question's option set. Numeric option labels beyond single characters can be mis-scored.

scientific_findings.finding: The empirical null generator does not exclude the real panel genes from each detectability-bin pool. draw_null_gene_set removes only genes already picked in the same draw, so null panels can resample genes from the tested panel itself. This contaminates the null toward the observed panel, with expected overlap increasing sharply for large panels, and also changes score_genes' internal control pool because the sampled null genes are excluded there. Cross-panel percentile comparisons (small D/P panels versus ~1,456-2,504-gene F panels) are therefore not on a trustworthy common calibration. The headline F-selective CRC conclusion depends on these percentiles and is blocked pending regeneration with disjoint null pools and donor-level reanalysis.

The matched HTAN analysis tests six panels with Wilcoxon and paired t-tests but applies no multiple-testing correction or family definition. More importantly, its panel percentiles inherit the contaminated null above. Patient is correctly used as the paired unit, but p<1e-4 and 26/29 direction counts cannot rescue a miscalibrated score and do not establish mechanism.

Track C is labeled independent validation but its Placenta arm has one donor and substitutes the broad HCL label 'Epithelial cell' for trophoblast because HCL exposes no trophoblast label. The code/report acknowledges this limitation; consequently Track C can be exploratory geometry only and cannot validate a trophoblast-specific axis or the founding cancer conclusion.

The 99th-percentile per-axis rescaling plus EPS closure creates relative visualization coordinates from non-isomorphic effect statistics. It is explicitly disclosed as a simplification, but coordinates are not probabilities and should not be used as quantitative evidence of developmental mixture without sensitivity analysis to scaling/EPS/universe choices.
